content.text: Digital creators often face [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|Payment Gateways]] processing challenges due to platform restrictions like Stripe unavailability or delayed payouts from services like Gumroad. In regions like Nigeria or Kenya, conventional payment methods can hinder your ability to sell digital products effectively. This guide will walk you through setting up NOWPayments webhooks using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-7|cloudflare]] Workers, enabling you to receive crypto payments seamlessly and efficiently. Prepare to gain control over your payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms can fail you when they are unavailable or impose restrictive conditions. NOWPayments offers a reliable alternative with a minimal 0.5% fee, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without the burden of KYC requirements. This infrastructure empowers you to bypass the obstacles that often arise with platforms like PayPal or Stripe, ensuring that your revenue stream remains uninterrupted. By utilizing decentralized payment methods, you can maintain full ownership of your financial transactions and enjoy low transaction costs, especially on networks like Tron, where USDT transactions cost under $0.10.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Preparation is key before launching your payment infrastructure. You will need a Cloudflare account and a GitHub account to host your application. Familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Workers, as these will handle backend logic for your payment processing. Additionally, set up a NOWPayments account to manage cryptocurrency transactions. It's also essential to create a Supabase instance for order storage and establish your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Once you have these accounts set up, you'll be equipped to proceed with the deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your Cloudflare Workers to handle webhook events from NOWPayments. Configure your worker to listen for payment confirmations and then trigger the appropriate file delivery from your storage solution. Ensure that your webhook URL is correctly set in your NOWPayments dashboard to facilitate real-time updates. Next, integrate your Supabase database to store order details and manage product deliveries efficiently. This setup guarantees that once a payment is confirmed, the product is delivered automatically, creating a seamless user experience for your customers.
NOWPayments enables instant payment confirmation without KYC hassles.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is established, it’s time to go live. Test your setup with a minimal transaction to ensure that your system is functioning as expected. Verify that your Cloudflare Worker correctly handles the webhook and that orders are logged in Supabase. After confirming successful transactions, promote your digital products using your store URL. You can showcase your offerings effectively at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, giving customers a direct path to purchase and ensuring you maximize your reach.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your payment infrastructure live, consider scaling to accommodate more products and traffic. Use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy additional features and streamline operations. Set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations for your email to enhance delivery rates and ensure your customers receive their purchase confirmations. Monitor transaction volumes and evaluate performance regularly to identify areas for improvement. This proactive approach ensures your infrastructure grows alongside your business demands, maintaining efficiency and reliability.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
USDT transactions on Tron keep your costs under $0.10.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account to host your application. Set up a GitHub account for version control. Establish a NOWPayments account to manage cryptocurrency transactions. Deploy Cloudflare Workers for webhook handling. Create a Supabase instance for order storage. Configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Test your payment pipeline to ensure functionality. Promote your store URL to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?
Sign up for NOWPayments to process crypto payments. Integrate their API with Cloudflare Workers to handle payment confirmations and automate product delivery to customers.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments on Tron typically confirm in seconds, while PayPal can take days for funds to appear in your account. This speed enhances cash flow and improves customer satisfaction.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?
Creators can use peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to Naira. These platforms facilitate direct transactions without the delays associated with traditional banking.
What are the fees associated with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive 0.5% fee on transactions. This structure allows you to retain more revenue compared to traditional payment processors.
Can I scale my infrastructure after deployment?
Yes, once your infrastructure is deployed, you can easily scale it by adding more products and utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack to enhance functionality and support increased traffic.
Cloudflare Workers streamline your payment logic for seamless transactions.
